data.value: Will State President F. W. de Klerk personally deliver the customary opening address to the South African Parliament during the first week of its February 1990 session?

The South African Parliament is set to open its 1990 session in the first week of February. The State President traditionally delivers the opening address. As of January 20, 1990, no official announcement has been made regarding whether President de Klerk will personally deliver the address or delegate it to another official. The address is scheduled to occur before the hard cutoff on February 6, 1990.
